name: 텍스트 압축 비율
description: 사용합니다 data compression algorithms 측정하기 위해 text redundancy and predictability as indicators of AI generation.
useCase: AI 생성 텍스트 감지 through lower information density and higher compressibility
mechanism: Compresses the input text using lossless algorithms (gzip, zlib, LZ77) and computes the 압축 비율 (compressed size / original size). AI 생성 text typically compresses more efficiently due to higher regularity, more repetitive 패턴, and lower information 엔트로피 compared to 인간 텍스트. The method also 분석 the 압축 비율 of sliding windows 감지하기 위해 segments with varying compressibility—a sign of mixed human/AI authorship.
source: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024) - Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education: A Comparative Study for ChatGPT Cases, IEEE Access
algorithm: Multi-Algorithm Compression + Ratio Analysis + Sliding Window Segmentation
parameters: Algorithms: gzip-9/zlib/brotli, Window: 200-500 chars sliding, Metrics: global ratio, segment ratios, ratio 분산, Min text: 200 words
strengths:
• 훈련 데이터 불필요 (unsupervised)
• Language and model agnostic
• Extremely fast computation
• Captures information-theoretic properties
limitations:
• Lower 정확도 on short texts
• Technical text with repeated terms compresses well naturally
• Depends on compression algorithm choice
• Not sensitive to semantic-level 패턴

references.title: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024). Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education. IEEE Access.
Benedetto, D. et al. (2002). Language Trees and Zipping. Physical Review Letters.
